assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was performed
CPT code 93229 was used for the service
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The denial was for lack of precertification or authorization obtained prior to the service date
Proper authorization should have been secured in a timely manner to establish coverage eligibility
